The '''Serabyss Howler 1165'''<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|III|33|Podracer}}</ref> was the [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] used by [[Knire Dark]]. It had surprisingly good turning abilities and cooling but didn't accelerate quickly.
